## What and why


## Checklist
- [ ] Only files inside the plugin changed (no core, theme, other plugin or mu-plugin)
- [ ] `npm run build` run and `build/` committed with the `src/` change
- [ ] `npm test` passes (and `npm run test:php` / `npm run test:e2e` if PHP or layout changed)
- [ ] Checked at 1440px and 390px; no sideways scroll
- [ ] Version bumped in four places and CHANGELOG updated (release-worthy change only)
- [ ] Docs updated (`docs/`, README) where behaviour changed
- [ ] New PHP override or hook is listed in the Developer guide, with a test
